meta.text: Here's the exam trap I want you to internalize. Shuffle Hash Join is often described as a no-shuffle join. That is wrong. In SHJ, the small side is still exchanged — it's shuffled and hashed, but only the small side is shuffled. The large side stays where it is. So SHJ is the middle ground: use it when the small side exceeds the broadcast threshold but the large side shouldn't be reshuffled.
